accepted.s: Who launched the ‘Swarna Andhra @2047’ vision on 13 December 2024?
accepted.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 was launched by Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on 13 December 2024.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the person associated with a policy launch.
accepted.sec: Vision and policy documents - goals and guiding principles

accepted.s: The ‘Swarna Andhra @2047’ vision of Andhra Pradesh is aligned with which national vision?
accepted.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 is aligned with the national goal of Viksit Bharat 2047.
accepted.tq: Identify the correctly associated national policy vision.
accepted.sec: Vision and policy documents - goals and guiding principles

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the stated goal of Swarna Andhra @2047?
accepted.x: The stated goal is to create a ‘Wealthy, Healthy, Happy Andhra’.

accepted.sec: Vision and policy documents - goals and guiding principles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Swarna Andhra @2047:
1. It contains 10 Padi Sutralu.
2. It covers 12 thematic sectors.
3. Its first full year is 2025–26.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 has 10 guiding principles, 12 thematic sectors and 2025–26 is its first full year.

accepted.s: The implementation of Swarna Andhra @2047 is monitored through which arrangement?

accepted.sec: Vision and policy documents - goals and guiding principles

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the target for GSDP under Swarna Andhra @2047?

accepted.tq: Separate the present value from the long-term target in a comparison table.

accepted.s: Under the Swarna Andhra @2047 targets, the intended per capita income by 2047 is:

accepted.tq: Test the exact target figure against nearby present and medium-term figures.
accepted.sec: Vision and policy documents - goals and guiding principles

accepted.s: Which target combination is correctly matched with Swarna Andhra @2047?
o: Unemployment — less than 2%; women’s workforce participation — more than 80%
Renewable share — exactly 50%; women’s workforce participation — less than 45%
Unemployment — more than 5.8%; renewable share — less than 30%
Women’s workforce participation — about 45.8%; unemployment — more than 2%
accepted.x: The 2047 targets are unemployment below 2% and women’s workforce participation above 80%. The renewable-share target is above 75%.
accepted.tq: Match two target columns rather than confusing present values with targets.
accepted.sec: Vision and policy documents - goals and guiding principles

GSDP of ₹308 lakh crore and per capita income of ₹55 lakh

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the draft Population Management Policy 2026:
1. It proposes an incentive of ₹25,000 for a second or third child.
2. It proposes removal of the two-child norm for local polls.
3. Andhra Pradesh’s total fertility rate is stated as 1.5.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the draft policy proposes a ₹25,000 incentive, removal of the two-child norm for local polls and records AP’s TFR as 1.5.
accepted.tq: Test several provisions of a policy through coded statements.
accepted.sec: Vision and policy documents - goals and guiding principles

accepted.s: The AP Municipal Laws (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2026 sought to restore:
o: Indirect election of all municipal councillors
Direct election of Mayors and municipal Chairpersons
Election of Mayors by the Zilla Parishad
Appointment of Mayors by the Governor
accepted.x: The Bill restored direct election of Mayors and municipal Chairpersons. Direct elections had existed from 1986 to 2005 and indirect elections had operated since 6 August 2005.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise institutional change proposed by a Bill.
accepted.sec: State legislation - Bills passed by the AP Assembly

accepted.s: Direct election of Mayors and municipal Chairpersons in Andhra Pradesh existed during which period before indirect elections were introduced?
accepted.x: Direct elections were in force from 1986 to 2005; indirect elections began from 6 August 2005.
accepted.tq: Distinguish adjacent historical periods using the start and end dates.

accepted.s: The AP Omnibus (Speed of Doing Business) Bill, 2026 amended which set of laws?
o: Fire Service Act 1999, Single Window Clearance Act 2002 and Public Service Delivery Guarantee Act 2017
Municipalities Act 1965, Panchayat Raj Act 1994 and RTI Act 2005
Industries Act 1987, Land Revenue Act 1901 and Shops Act 1956
Fire Service Act 2002, Single Window Act 2017 and Service Guarantee Act 1999
accepted.x: The Omnibus Bill amended the Fire Service Act 1999, Single Window Clearance Act 2002 and Public Service Delivery Guarantee Act 2017.

accepted.s: The AP Panchayat Raj (Second Amendment) Bill, 2026 proposed a return to:

Two Vice-Presidents per MPP and two Vice-Chairpersons per ZPP
